title: Deliver Oil to Fort Wadham Oil Refinery
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Oil** delivered to **Fort Wadham Oil Refinery** (industry id 10, near tile 239,164).

A likely supplier is **Fort Wadham Oil Wells** (industry id 36, near tile 234,183); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
